name: Asahina Yuusuke
source:
Birth Date: 1994/03/31.
Occupation: Second year student in Hinode High School; Ema's classmate. 

Yuusuke is the 11th son of the Asahina family. He’s a second year student in Hinode High School. He’s also [url=/c10574]Ema[/url]’s classmate at school, so he was really shocked when she moved in to live with them. Even though he looks and behaves like a wild yankee, Yuusuke has a really strong sense of justice. He hates everything twisted, often getting into a fight with delinquents to defend what’s right. His grades are as red as his hair, but he’s athletic and good in sports.

[From [url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2012/05/30/brothers-conflict-passion-pink-yusuke/]Love-Colored Sky[/url]]
